We need answer Chinese econ multiple choice. Need analyze. Question: 新凯恩斯主义者认为，劳动供过于求时，____。 Options:
A. 会产生非自愿性失业
B. 工资会跌落
C. 一方面会产生非自愿性失业，一方面工资会跌落
D. 工资并不会跌落，非自愿性失业也不会产生

Need choose correct. New Keynesians: labor supply exceeds demand (excess supply) -> wages are sticky down? They would not fall fully? Non-voluntary unemployment? Let's think.

In macro, Keynesian: wages are sticky, so excess supply of labor leads to involuntary unemployment; wages do not adjust downward (or adjust slowly). New Keynesians emphasize downward nominal/real wage rigidity due to contracts, coordination failure, efficiency wages etc. Thus labor supply > demand: involuntary unemployment exists, but wages do not necessarily fall to clear market. If options: A: would produce involuntary unemployment. B: wages fall. C: both involuntary unemployment and wage fall. D: no wage fall, no involuntary unemployment. New Keynesians likely A? The statement "劳动供过于求时" means labor market has excess supply. In standard Keynesian, because wages don't fall, involuntary unemployment. New Keynesians also emphasize wage rigidity, so wage won't fall (or less flexible) and nonvoluntary unemployment. But among options, A only says involuntary unemployment, not wage won't fall. D says no wage fall and no involuntary unemployment (contradiction). C says both unemployment and wage fall (classical?). If new Keynesians believe wages are sticky downward, labor supply excess -> nonvoluntary unemployment, wages not fall. None of options exactly. Maybe the exam expects: New Keynesians argue labor supply excess will not make wages fall, but leads to involuntary unemployment. Which option closest? A says produces involuntary unemployment, doesn't mention wage. B false. C says wages fall, false. D says no wage fall and no involuntary unemployment, false. So A is best.

Need ensure: Some Chinese textbooks: 新凯恩斯主义认为，劳动供过于求时，工资并不会跌落，因此会产生非自愿失业? But no option with both. Maybe A because the question asks blank: "劳动供过于求时，____。" Options: A produce involuntary unemployment; B wage falls; C both; D wage not fall, involuntary unemployment not produced. If new Keynesians emphasize nominal wage rigidity: when labor supply > demand, the market clearing wage would be below current; wages do not fall, so quantity supplied > demanded; nonvoluntary unemployment arises. Thus A is true (involuntary unemployment), B false, C false because wage won't fall, D false because unemployment does arise. So A.

Need final line 答案：A.

content:
新凯恩斯主义强调工资存在向下刚性，因此在劳动供过于求时，工资未必会下跌到出清水平，从而会产生非自愿性失业。

答案：A
